notes:
— Account brief: Axion DevSearch is building an enterprise code search product for large monorepos (consumer-facing internal tools for multiple business units). Evaluating Redwood for embeddings + reranking pipeline.

— Scale & perf profile: targeting ~50M embeddings total, ingest delta of ~5M embeddings/day during heavy indexing. Peak query pattern: 200 QPS across global regions; median query picks 100 candidates for reranking. Goal: P99 end-to-end rerank latency <150ms (target), cost per query <= $0.005 (goal).

— POC summary (Feb–Mar):
  * Kickoff 2026-02-12 (see ff_20260212) — ingest pipeline connected to sample monorepo, generated 10M embeddings for smoke tests.
  * Hosted Redwood baseline: 100-candidate rerank P50 ~60ms, P99 ~220ms. Cost estimate extrapolated: ~$0.009/query at current batching.
  * Dedicated config (GPU pool) test: P50 ~45ms, P99 ~110ms for same workload; cost per query modelled ~$0.0045 with caching + batching.
  * Reranking model: hybrid embedding + light cross-encoder for rerank (candidate set size 100 -> cross-encoder on top 32).

— Requirements captured in discovery:
  * SSO / SAML integration mandatory (enterprise SAML IdP).
  * Audit logging + per-token billing logs for chargeback.
  * Data residency: EU customer data must remain in specified region (on-prem or EU VPC).
  * Reindex cadence: daily delta + full weekly snapshot. Reindex must not break availability (rolling reindex preferred).

— Security & procurement path: legal requested SOC2 report and encryption keyflow (KMS/HSM). Security FAQ provided (drive:/security/axion/security-faq-axion-2026-02.docx). Main legal blocker: SLA language around P99 and data deletion/retention.

— Quotes from the call: CTO: "Deterministic P99 matters more than average — if we spike, customers notice immediately." Product lead: "We need predictable billing and clear knobs for caching and candidate window size."

  1) Marcus to share dedicated capacity sizing + cost model by 2026-03-06. (done: model in drive).
